summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Judgments
summary.text: Catalog entries 144–148 and untitled astrological questions cross-referenced to Codices Venet. 6 and 7, including quadrants from Paulus Alexandrinus, horoscopy, royal dignity and authority, weather, disasters, travel and migration, illness and death, hidden treasure, conflict, success, marriage, returning spouses, and runaways.
